description: Add comprehensive fast-check property tests covering replay determinism, precedence, boundary conditions, missing evidence, evaluation errors, and high-concurrency limit reservation scenarios.
findings: 33 tests total: replay determinism (2), precedence (4), boundary conditions (6), missing evidence (8), evaluation errors (3), high concurrency (4), engine integration (3), package identity (3). All pass with fast-check property-based testing using fc.assert/fc.property/fc.asyncProperty patterns.
